shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; rg -n 'PromptBuilderConfig|baseSystemPrompt' src; cat package.json; git status --short; ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts; rg -n 'chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance|runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws' specs; cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"  baseSystemPrompt: 'You are HAL.',\\n  systemPromptSuffix: 'Be precise.',\\n  contextConfig: {\\n    historyLength: 10,\\n    includeTimestamps: false,\\n    includeSystemPrompt: true,\\n  },\", \"  identity: 'You are HAL.',\\n  responseGuidelines: 'Be precise.',\")
s=s.replace(\"    await expect(orchestrator.processMessage(createSession('hello'))).rejects.toThrow(\\n      'Database connection failed in beforeSession'\\n    );\\n\\n    expect(caughtError).toBe(errorToThrow);\\n    expect(afterSessionRan).toBe(true);\", \"    const rejection = await orchestrator.processMessage(createSession('hello')).then(\\n      () => undefined,\\n      (error: unknown) => error\\n    );\\n\\n    expect({rejectedWithOriginal: rejection === errorToThrow, caughtOriginal: caughtError === errorToThrow, afterSessionRan}).toEqual({\\n      rejectedWithOriginal: true,\\n      caughtOriginal: true,\\n      afterSessionRan: true,\\n    });\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n 'runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#L40', 'chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#L35')
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff"

/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md

git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git status -sb"
